sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "weekly_weather"."station_id" AS e, AVG("weekly_weather"."precipitation") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("weekly_weather"."low_temperature" - "weekly_weather"."high_temperature") AS REAL) / "weekly_weather"."high_temperature")) AS m2 FROM "weekly_weather" GROUP BY "weekly_weather"."station_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10

why: average of chance of precipitation per station (by station_id)
